# GSAP 3.15.0 License Statements (Verbatim From Package)

The `gsap@3.15.0` npm package ships no standalone `LICENSE` file. Its licence is declared in three places inside the published package (`gsap-3.15.0.tgz`, registry integrity `sha512-dMW4CWBTUK1AEEDeZc1g4xpPGIrSf9fJF960qbTZmN/QwZIWY5wgliS6JWl9/25fpTGJrMRtSjGtOmPnfjZB+A==`), quoted verbatim below. GSAP is licensed under the **GSAP Standard No-Charge License (Webflow), not open source**, and is not covered by this repository's Apache-2.0 license.

Full terms URL: https://gsap.com/standard-license

## 1. `package.json` (line 66, verbatim)

```json
"license": "Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license."
```

## 2. `README.md` — `### License` (lines 90–93, verbatim)

```markdown
### License
GreenSock's standard "no charge" license can be viewed at <a href="https://gsap.com/standard-license">https://gsap.com/standard-license</a>.

Copyright (c) 2008-2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved.
```
